subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu add a supported inbound attachment-context opt-out, and what canonical config name/default/inheritance behavior should it use?
rationale: The requested key is unparsed and undocumented today, while honoring it would add a new plugin-owned config/default surface that affects context behavior and upgrades.

options.title: Add a Feishu-owned opt-out
options.body: Add a documented Feishu top-level/per-account option with current media download behavior as the default and placeholder-only behavior when disabled.

options.title: Use a shared channel policy
options.body: Create or reuse a broader channel attachment-ingestion policy if maintainers want one canonical config shape across plugins.

options.title: Document as unsupported
options.body: Document that Feishu currently supports `mediaMaxMb` but no attachment-content ignore switch, then close the expectation as unsupported.

recommendation.title: Add a Feishu-owned opt-out
recommendation.body: Add a documented Feishu top-level/per-account option with current media download behavior as the default and placeholder-only behavior when disabled.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman has the strongest recent merged Feishu media/docs history across the affected code and docs surfaces.
